RDFLib

RDFLib, is python package used to create and manipulate Resource Description Framework (RDF) data.

RDFLib links

  • RDFLib's home on GitHub - for developers
  • RDFLib on PyPI - for Python users
  • RDFLib's documentation website
  • RDF Dataset example - as this has proven hard to find

KurrawongAI staff have been core contributors to RDFLib for 8 years and currently lead the maintenance of it.

Recent applications

Note

We maintain the kurra toolkit we use for many manual and infracode RDF management tasks. It is built on top of RDFLib, as is KGM, our RDF DB management tool and pyLODE the opne source ontology/vocabulary documentation tool we use

  • training for the ICSM ANZ Address Model which used RDFLib to manipulate RDF data
  • lectures over several years at the Australian National University for the IT Masters course COMP 7230 on Semantic Web / Linked Data creation and use
  • implementing Python client libraries for GraphWise's GraphDB application
  • building the Prez Linked Data application

Services Offered

Due to our long and current engagement with RDFLib, we can:

  • build custom data Knowledge Graph and web applications
    • including web APIs, UIs, ETL code, infracode
  • develop RDFLib for clients' use
  • support any aspects of RDFLib use
